commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and David Lopez comes onto the pitch so that Alejandro Frances (Girona) can be given a rest.

90+2' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Viktor Tsygankov slips the ball through to Claudio Echeverri (Girona), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 3:0.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' A mistake by a defender gifts Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
84' Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
84' Girona get a corner.
83' Michel prepares a substitution. Azzedine Ounahi is replaced by Abel Ruiz (Girona).
83' Joel Roca goes off the pitch and Alex Moreno (Girona) comes on.
82' The foul by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Iosu Galech.
82' Ath Bilbao win a corner.
81' The ball goes behind for a corner. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
80' Ernesto Valverde has decided to substitute Inaki Williams and he is replaced by Izeta (Ath Bilbao).

77' 2 - 0 Claudio Echeverri sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 2:0.
74' The referee signals a substitution. Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) is brought on as a substitute for Oihan Sancet.
73' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is yellow-carded.
70' Substitution. Fran Beltran makes way for Ivan Martin (Girona).
70' Michel decides to make a substitution. Vladyslav Vanat will be replaced by Claudio Echeverri (Girona).
68' Here comes a substitution. Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) is brought on as a substitute for Mikel Jauregizar.
68' Ath Bilbao force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
67' Ath Bilbao force a corner. They send men into the box.
67' The referee signals a corner kick to Ath Bilbao.
63' The Ath Bilbao players are exchanging some short passes.

62' Aymeric Laporte (Ath Bilbao) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.

60' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Unai Simon thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
59' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) plays the ball to Inaki Williams with a cheeky pass and their attacking move continues.
56' Girona are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
55' The ball is cleared after Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
54' A cross from a corner kick by Ath Bilbao is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
53' Neat passing move from Girona in order to create new attacking opportunities.
51' Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
48' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Paulo Gazzaniga pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
47' Ath Bilbao force their opponents to concede a corner.
46' The game is over for Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao). Jesus Areso comes on for the second half.
46' Ernesto Valverde makes a half-time substitution. Gorka Guruzeta comes on in place of Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Iosu Galech blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Iosu Galech interrupts the game. One of the players from Ath Bilbao won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
41' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
41' The ball is out of play. Girona win a corner kick.

40' Unai Simon pulls off a great save to deny Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! The linesman makes the right call and Girona will have a corner.
38' Great teamplay by Ath Bilbao as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
37' Hugo Rincon (Girona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
35' The ratio of the ball possession is 52:48.
31' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
30' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Iosu Galech stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
29' Axel Witsel (Girona) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
28' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) brings an opponent down and Iosu Galech interrupts the game.
27' Joel Roca (Girona) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The linesman signals a throw-in for Ath Bilbao.
26' Girona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
25' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
24' The Girona players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
24' PENALTY APPEAL by Girona, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
23' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

22' A through ball from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) fails to reach Inaki Williams as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Inaki Williams could have got into a promising position.

20' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He creates some space for the shot, but blazes it high over the crossbar. Very bad attempt. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
19' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Paulo Gazzaniga and he's equal to it.
18' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Unai Simon comes off the line to clear the ball away.
17' Robert Navarro latches onto a perfect defence-splitting pass from Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) and heads towards goal.
15' The corner from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is cleared away by the defence.
15' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee blows his whistle, Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
14' Ath Bilbao enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
12' The Ath Bilbao players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
11' Girona control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
9' The game is interrupted. Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
8' Paulo Gazzaniga displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
7' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Ath Bilbao.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Hugo Rincon (Girona) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Viktor Tsygankov, then sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
3' The Girona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

3' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Girona.
1' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
1' Ath Bilbao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Ath Bilbao will have the kick-off.
Iosu Galech was nominated as the referee for this game.
